# Extract the home team score from the string format (e.g., "9.11 (65)") for rows where away team is 'melbourne'
melbourne_away_home_scores = df[df['away team'] == 'melbourne']['home team score'].str.extract(r'\((\d+)\)').astype(int)

# Find the minimum home team score when Melbourne is the away team
min_melbourne_away_home_score = melbourne_away_home_scores.min().iloc[0]

# Get all home team scores across the dataframe
all_home_scores = df['home team score'].str.extract(r'\((\d+)\)').astype(int)

# Find the minimum home team score among all rows
min_all_home_score = all_home_scores.min().iloc[0]

# Check if the minimum home team score when Melbourne is away equals the overall minimum home team score
answer = (min_melbourne_away_home_score == min_all_home_score)
